You may find this useful if you are using the Steam version without Steam.

If you want to connect to a server IP not on the same LAN, the server will need to port forward port 24642
[b]Be aware you should not give out your IP to people you don't trust.

[/b]Use this to change the server port: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2993]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2993[/url]
